integrity: The proof reconstructs Niu's exact stabilizer formula, proves the sign extension splits using a hyperelliptic involution, and proves the mod-p orbit bounds from squared Dehn twists and symplectic transvections. The finite verifier is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to Niu's marked ordinary untwisted single-rim-surgery surfaces in genus at least three. The mod-p statements are finite-action lower bounds, not exact subgroup indices and not a complete detector of nonextendability.
title: Congruence orbit witnesses and an index-two jump for rim-surgery extendable groups
